# Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs)

## **Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs)**

Trialed using young Swedish bone derived mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) from CellcoLabs. In March 2024, I had 300 million MSCs injected into my knees, hips and shoulders. Follow up MRI is in 12 months. ([watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MsVIT_54rMU))
